sources.scope: Saarland; qualifying Rhine low-water replacement transport and associated empty journeys; through 31 October 2026 inclusive

sources.version: Resolution 14 January 2026; sections B.2 and B.3
sources.scope: Territory subject to this DGT resolution; retain autonomous authority boundaries
sources.finding: B.2 links orange-panel ADR vehicles to Annex V and, when MAM/combination MAM exceeds 7500 kg, Annex II. These categories must not become one universal >7.5 t rule.

sources.scope: Mainland Portugal; specific dangerous-goods vehicle categories
sources.finding: Article 2 sets 00:00-24:00 Sunday/holiday restrictions for the tank category, with the stated Saturday/Monday holiday exception. Articles 3-4 contain different road/time/direction conditions for the specified dangerous-goods categories; article 5 permits the covered vehicles on Ponte 25 de Abril/north viaduct only 02:00-05:00. Articles 6-8 contain tunnel rules, substantive exceptions and special authorisations. Do not transfer this mainland regime to Madeira/Azores or ordinary non-ADR freight.

The amendment changes articles 2, 5, 7 and 8 of Portaria 281/2019. The similarly numbered April education measure is unrelated. The official IMT notice confirms the mainland ADR scope; its obsolete detail link redirects to the homepage, so the legal text is used directly.
